summary.text: Bernie Hayes is the Republican candidate for Iowa State Senate District 39 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Democrat Liz Bennett.
Hayes has run for the Iowa legislature before, including in 2018, 2022 and a 2025 special election.

paragraphs.text: Hayes was the Republican nominee for Iowa State Senate District 33 in 2018, when incumbent Robert Hogg defeated him in the general election, 65.5 percent to 34.4 percent.
In 2022 he won the Republican primary for Iowa State Senate District 39 and lost the general election to Liz Bennett, 64.8 percent to 35.1 percent.
In the April 29, 2025 special general election for Iowa House of Representatives District 78, Angel Ramirez defeated Hayes, 79.1 percent to 20.8 percent.
For 2026 he is again on the ballot for Senate District 39; the Republican primary scheduled for June 2, 2026 was canceled.
